flow.caption_zh: 北非的斜陽把撒哈拉沙漠

zh: 延展成一幅褶皺的横軸
地中海吹來的風，是一世紀
大西洋吹來的風，是一世紀
en: Unfolding into a creased horizontal scroll
Yellow sand stretching vast, the wind sighing mournfully
Civilization has trudged its way here
Weary footsteps, can only
Kneading unsteadily
Ripples crisscrossing this way and that
A helpless sigh
Layer upon layer of desolation
Winding, trailing distance
A wordless waiting
The wind blowing from the Mediterranean is a century
The wind blowing from the Atlantic is a century
And on a windless night
Heaven and earth in their primeval chaos
The starry sky lies silent

zh: 沙漠是不立文字的稿紙
還有吉普車戰車坦克車
en: Vast and winding, wide open and blank
The desert is a manuscript page with no words written
Every ripple
Holding within it a lingering question
Every footprint
Telling a story
Of camels, of horses, of traders
The explorer's, the wanderer's, the slave's
Those with swords at their waist, those holding scripture
There are also jeeps, armored cars, and tanks
Deep tracks of passing wheels
Footprint covers footprint
Story layered upon story
Wind blowing through a thousand ages
Took not a single word away

zh: 是一種月升星沉的孤獨
en: Keeping watch at the desert's edge
It is a loneliness of moonrise and star-fall
Like looking back on yesterday
Questioning amid the wind of another age
The helplessness of crumbling walls and ruined ramparts
The sigh of a rotted, broken stump
Gazing as far as the eye can reach
The sun sinking over the dunes
How, in the far distance where heaven and earth blend
Drifting in the illusion of primal color

zh: 踟蹰於橄㰖色的夜空下
沉澱成明日詩意的心情
en: Hesitating beneath an olive-colored night sky
What drifted faintly through the heart
Like starlight
Like a Buddhist chant
Like the echo of camel bells receding into the distance
Has never once vanished
remain
Swaying upon the level sand
Weathered away in the wind
Like mystery, doubt, rapt attention, and being moved
Like a quiet, gentle beauty
Like the depth of emptiness
All, one by one, have also run aground
Between ripple and ripple
Settling into tomorrow's poetic mood

zh: 如綠洲夜晚浮現的風景
en: Perhaps when youth has aged away
Deep feeling drifts far like the wind
Still pacing across the boundless desert
Between footprint and footprint
Picking up memory
Rereading a scattered, lost story
And moreover
Believing recklessly
The years remain silent still
With another state of mind
Like a dune
Like a windless border
Like a scene that surfaces at an oasis by night
